name: protheus-engineering-agent
description: Standalone, evidence-backed engineering tools for ADVPL/TLPP projects in VS Code.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Open a trusted workspace before allowing an engineering agent to inspect project files.

walkthroughs.title: Start with evidence-backed Protheus review
walkthroughs.description: Validate the workspace, index ADVPL/TLPP sources, and publish review findings to Problems.

steps.title: Validate the workspace
steps.description: Run [Protheus Agent: Doctor](command:pea.doctor) to verify local, offline readiness.

steps.title: Build the project evidence map
steps.description: Run [Protheus Agent: Index Workspace](command:pea.indexWorkspace) to index supported sources.

steps.title: Review the active source
steps.description: Open an ADVPL/TLPP file and run [Protheus Agent: Review Active ADVPL/TLPP File](command:pea.reviewActiveFile). Findings appear in Problems.

commands.title: Protheus Agent: Review Active ADVPL/TLPP File
